items.title: Keep cleared dashboard logs empty when new events arrive
items.body:
## Problem

The stream hook stores activity and console rows both in atoms and in private refs. Clear actions empty the atoms, but the next websocket message appends to the old ref and restores the cleared rows.

## Changes

Update the current atom values directly. Keep command/result replacement and the 500-row limit. Add a regression that delivers messages to the production hook using a controlled transport and a real Jotai store, then clears each log and delivers another message. The existing dashboard CI build runs the test.

## Validation

Verified commit `2d403028f8920a0741e9ac1d94ec7418397dd8b1` in [GitHub Actions](https://github.com/Afloat16/claude-mem/actions/runs/42633003467/job/129213810307) using Node 24 and pnpm 11.1.3.

- `pnpm install --frozen-lockfile --filter dashboard` — passed.
- `pnpm --filter dashboard build` — passed, including the committed dashboard regression tests and Next.js production build.

items.title: Reload dashboard activity when a session reconnects on a new port
items.body:
## Problem

Persisted activity is restored only when the session name changes. A restarted daemon can keep that name and get a new stream port. Once live stream rows reset, the old restored prefix can replace the more recent persisted history. A render captured before a session switch can also write its rows under the new session's key.

## Changes

Associate restored rows with both the session name and port, reload them for a new daemon port, and save only history belonging to the current selection. Add a regression using the production hook, controlled effects, and a real Jotai store. The dashboard build runs the test in CI.

## Validation

items.title: Report malformed dashboard command responses as errors
items.body:
## Problem

A response can fail while its JSON body is decoded after fetch resolves. The command and kill helpers returned that promise directly, so their catch blocks did not handle these failures. HTTP failures and malformed result objects could also reach callers as successful command responses.

## Changes

Await body decoding, validate the expected result fields, preserve useful server errors, and turn unsuccessful HTTP responses into failed results. Add six regression cases and run dashboard tests before the dashboard build so the existing CI job executes them.

## Validation

items.title: Read dashboard storage values from command response envelopes
items.body:
## Problem

The storage panel reads cookie and Web Storage values from fields outside the CLI response's data envelope. Valid results therefore appear empty or show response metadata as storage keys. Cookies sharing a name and domain also collide when their paths differ.

## Changes

Decode data.cookies and data.data through checked helpers, retain a stored key named length, and identify cookie rows by domain, path, and name. Add five regression cases and run dashboard tests before the existing CI build.

items.title: Keep stale storage requests from replacing the active session data
items.body:
## Problem

A storage response can arrive after the user selects another session or storage tab. The old request then writes its values into the active panel and can clear the loading indicator while the current request is still pending.

## Changes

Route storage reads through a request generation that owns both result and completion callbacks. Invalidate that generation when the panel changes scope or unmounts, and reset values when the active session disappears. Add deferred-response tests for stale results, cleanup, and current-request failures. The existing dashboard CI build runs these tests.

items.title: Allow retrying dashboard session closes after a failure
items.body:
## Problem

Close and kill actions mark a session as closing and discard its chat before the request completes. If the request fails, the closing marker remains, so the session cannot be retried and its chat has already been lost. Bulk close follows the same path.

## Changes

Use one asynchronous stop action, discard chat after success, and remove the closing marker after a failed or rejected request. Keep successful sessions marked until polling confirms their removal. Add a regression against the production action atoms using a real Jotai store and deferred transport results.

## Validation

Verified commit `f461d0272cc03143ca9e7d6391560655c5a5ec65` in [GitHub Actions](https://github.com/Afloat16/claude-mem/actions/runs/42633003467/job/129213811150) using Node 24 and pnpm 11.1.3.

items.title: Keep dashboard network responses attached to their selected request
items.body:
## Problem

Network list and detail requests can complete out of order. A response body from the previously expanded request can appear beneath the newly selected URL. Session and filter changes, collapse, or clearing the list can also leave earlier responses able to update the current panel.

## Changes

Give list and detail requests independent generations, invalidate them when their scope ends, and keep their completion callbacks attached to the active request. Clearing and collapsing also invalidate pending detail reads. Add deferred-response tests for stale completion, cleanup, failure, and independent list/detail requests; run them in the dashboard CI build.

## Validation

items.title: Stop overlapping dashboard session polls and cancel them on cleanup
items.body:
## Problem

The session poll uses a fixed interval even when the previous session or tab request is still pending. Slow requests can overlap and apply results out of order. Unmounting clears the interval but leaves its active fetches able to update shared session state.

## Changes

Schedule the next poll after the current session and tab requests finish. Pass an AbortSignal to those requests, abort them during cleanup, and reject late results even if the transport completes after cancellation. Add a regression with deferred fetches, controlled timers, and the production hook's real Jotai store.

## Validation

Verified commit `77619057055cf737668aa30fff5f9cdd234a986e` in [GitHub Actions](https://github.com/Afloat16/claude-mem/actions/runs/42633003467/job/129213810938) using Node 24 and pnpm 11.1.3.

items.title: Discard stale dashboard frames and release decoded image bitmaps
items.body:
## Problem

Frame decoding is asynchronous. An obsolete frame can finish after a newer frame or after the viewport effect is cleaned up and overwrite the canvas. Decode failures also reject without a handler, and a draw failure can skip bitmap cleanup.

## Changes

Give every frame effect a cancellation callback, draw only while that effect is current, and close decoded bitmaps in a finally block. Add regression cases for successful drawing, cleanup during decoding, and rejected decodes. The dashboard build runs the tests in CI.

## Validation

items.title: Keep the dashboard usable when browser storage is unavailable
items.body:
## Problem

The persisted-activity atom reads localStorage during module initialization, and the persistence toggle writes to it without catching access errors. A browser that denies storage access can therefore prevent the dashboard from loading or interrupt the toggle after its in-memory state changes.

## Changes

Use guarded browser storage helpers for activity preferences and history. The UI can keep its in-memory state when storage is blocked or full. Add tests for denied access, failed operations, server rendering without window, and ordinary storage behavior; run them in the dashboard build.

## Validation
